notablePrerequisites: You have at least five devotion to any color.
description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping Ancestral Statue and the Incubator token, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
